component.name: Castaway
component.summary: A complete, self-hosted podcast management system

description.p: Castaway is a self-hosted podcast manager. Your subscriptions, listening progress and downloads live on your own server, and follow you between the web, desktop and mobile apps. It supports multiple users, and works with gpodder-compatible sync so you can keep using apps like AntennaPod too.
This is the desktop client. It needs a Castaway server to connect to.
Castaway is based on PinePods by Gooseberry Development.
